title: Nerja (another world)!
text: Incredible tour to the Nerja Caves and the town which also showcased the Balcon de Europa. Pictures cannot shown how amazing it was to be underground in a huge cave full of staglamites. The town itself felt like a tropical getaway from Granada.  Our guide Michael was fabulous, informative and our small group felt like friends.
author: Teresa_M

title: Great experience
text:
Great guide, Mickael is dynamic, attentive, and shares very good anecdotes.
The organization was top-notch, from the pickup at the hotel to the return.
I highly recommend it!
author: Lisa_G

title: Nerja Caves and Almunecar from Granada
text:
The hosts, Micheal and Alessandra were incredibly pleasant, very knowledgeable and fun to be with. It was obvious they really enjoyed their work. They were extremely punctual and respectful. They took their time explaining important facts and history about each stop and were eager to answer any of our questions. The Nerja caves are spectacular and the towns of Almunecar and Nerja are very beautiful. It was a very full day but before we knew it, we were back in Granada. The whole trip exceeded our expectations! Thank you so much, Micheal and Alessandra! 

Bonny and Paul from Newfoundland, Canad
author: Bonny_S

title: A great day out by the sea and under the ground.
text: The guide Michael ensured that we had an enjoyable experience of the Tropical Coast and the caves at Nerja. My partner really enjoyed this birthday treat.

title: Un tour excelente

title: I would recommend it without hesitation

title: A great day out from Granada exploring the coast!
text: Michael was a terrific guide, and we explored a variety of places along the coast and the caves at Nerja. He sprinked some history and personal experiences into the tour that made a nice connection to our trip in Spain.

title: Nerja Caves
text: A highly recommended excursion. Both the guide Dante and the driver Jesús were very friendly. Dante made the trip very enjoyable thanks to his explanations and leaving enough time to see each place calmly. The caves are spectacular.
author: 35mare

title: Visit the caves of Nerja, Tropical
text: Extremely great outing, thanks to Dante, with his great knowledge of history and legends, the caves are fantastic, but the rest of the outing, thanks to Dante and of course Jesus, the great driver, was tremendously good. At the same time, it must also be said that the food, without being bad, was not very satisfactory, so we have to lower the grade and leave the food at a 3.
